articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Tech stocks see monster rally after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO
articles.description: The Nasdaq slid 10% last week in its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020.

articles.title: Why One Math Proof Has AI Experts Warning Humans Might Soon Lose Control
articles.description: Alexandr Wang says Claude’s role in a verified Riemann Hypothesis proof signals a turning point, warning that powerful self-improving AI systems could advance faster than people can supervise them.

articles.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Stock skyrockets 31%
articles.description: The Nvidia board said it had input from senior levels of the U.S. government.

articles.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
articles.description: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

articles.title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44 billion deal as AI supercharges cyberattacks
articles.description: CrowdStrike and competitors have shelled out billions to ramp up defenses in the wake of AI cyberattacks.

articles.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
articles.description: The influential central banker expressed confidence that inflation will get closer to the Fed's 2% target in 2027.

articles.title: Jensen Huang cheered by Nvidia employees after return, pledges to be a better CEO
articles.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a note to employees on Nov. 8 and resigned as CEO on Nov. 12.

articles.title: Kalshi secures temporary win in New York gambling law dispute
articles.description: The ruling allows Kalshi to continue operating as its legal battle with New York over sports-related event contracts moves toward a January hearing.

articles.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
articles.description: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."

articles.title: Nvidia breathes new life into the AI trade. Plus, Qnity inks a smart deal to get stronger
articles.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

articles.title: Why Nvidia Needed Jensen Huang Back—And What His Return Really Changes
articles.description: Huang's 11-day absence exposed the importance of his customer ties, influence in Washington and hold on Silicon Valley. The stock is soaring, but the comeback brings risks of its own.

articles.title: Average 401(k), IRA balances fall as more workers raid their accounts, Fidelity says
articles.description: Retirement account balances fell in the third quarter amid market swings, according to Fidelity. At the same time, more savers tapped their accounts for cash.

articles.title: Trump administration proposes rule that could curb ESG investing in 401(k)s
articles.description: The Labor Department proposed a regulation Monday that seeks to curb uptake of ESG funds in workplace retirement plans such as 401(k)s.

articles.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
articles.description: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

articles.title: Amazon to acquire AI startup Decart's chip software, hire founders
articles.description: Decart, founded in 2023, is best known for its software that lets developers sync their AI models across different chips.

articles.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
articles.description: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

articles.title: DNI Jay Clayton tapped as acting national cyber director
articles.description: President Donald Trump last week said he decided to replace Sean Cairncross as national cyber director "because I didn't think that person was good enough."

articles.title: ESPN, NFL to show Super Bowl 61 in Imax theaters
articles.description: In addition to ESPN channels, Super Bowl 61 will also be available on streaming platform Disney+ as well as the company's broadcast network ABC.

articles.description: Nvidia shareholders can look to the options market to recoup lost money
